try: Open the list of keyboard shortcuts
how:
1. On Leads, click an empty part of the page
2. Press ?
3. Read the panel, then look at the page beside it
4. Press Esc
expect: A "Keyboard shortcuts" panel opens on the right; the page narrows to make room. It lists "On this page · Leads" first (Next lead, Create New Lead, Filters…), then Everywhere, then "In dialogs and menus". While it is out, the page's own buttons wear their keys in small purple badges (F on Filters, V on the view toggle, G then L on Leads in the side navigation). Esc closes it.

try: Walk the list without the mouse
how:
1. On Leads press J, J, then K
2. Press X, then ⌫ (Backspace)
3. Press Esc in the question, then Esc twice more
expect: J and K move an outline from lead to lead; X ticks the lead under it; ⌫ asks "Delete …?" before anything happens. Esc closes the question, then removes the outline, then clears the tick.

try: Open a lead and move around it
how:
1. Press J, then ↵
2. Press 2, then 1
3. Press J
4. Press M, Esc, then A, Esc, then E, Esc
5. Press Esc
expect: ↵ opens the lead; 2 opens its Tasks tab and 1 its Overview; J opens the next lead of the list you came from; M opens the stage menu, A Assign, E Edit lead; Esc with nothing open goes back to the list.

how:
1. Press G and wait a moment
2. Press T
3. Press G then P
4. Press G then L
expect: After a beat a dark bar lists the places (D Dashboard, L Leads, P Projects, T Tasks, Q Quotes, C Contracts, X Quote X-Ray, V AI Visualizer, B Price book, F Finance, M Messages, N Notifications, S Settings); T goes to Tasks; G then P to Projects; G then L back to Leads.

try: Create, filter and switch the view from the keyboard
how:
1. On Leads press C, then Esc
2. Press F, then Esc
3. Press V, then V again
4. Open a lead's Quotes tab and press C
expect: C opens Create New Lead; F opens Filters; V switches between the table and the board; on the Quotes tab C opens Create Quote.

how:
1. Open a draft quote
2. Press ?, read it, press Esc
3. Press ⌘F (Ctrl+F), then Esc
4. Press ⌘S (Ctrl+S)
5. Press 3
6. Press P
expect: The panel lists the editor's own keys (the Items table's Tab, ↵, F2, ⌘D, Undo, Redo, Find in the quote, Preview, Switch tabs). ⌘F opens the Items table's Find, not the browser's; ⌘S says "Saved — everything saves as you type"; 3 jumps to Payment Schedule; P opens Preview.

how:
1. Open a lead's Files tab
2. Press J until the outline is on a file, then X
3. Press ⌫, then ⌘↵ (Ctrl+Enter)
4. Press ⌘Z (Ctrl+Z)
expect: ⌘↵ answers "Move to Trash Folder?" with its button; the message "Moved to Trash Folder" offers Undo, and ⌘Z presses it — the file is back.

try: Let the app teach a key
how:
1. On Leads hover the Filters button and read the tooltip
2. Click Filters and close it — three times
3. Wait a moment
expect: The tooltip reads "Filters" with an F key. After the third click with the mouse, one message says "Next time, press F for Filters." with "All shortcuts"; it comes once for that key, and at most one tip a day.

try: Keys you have used are ticked
how:
1. Press ?
2. Read the line under the chips
3. Press J with the panel open
expect: "You use n of … here" counts the keys you have used on this page; used keys carry a tick; pressing J flashes its row in the panel.

how:
1. Press ?, switch "Single-key shortcuts" off, press Esc
2. Press J, then ↓
3. Press ⌘/ (Ctrl+/), switch it back on
expect: The single keys read "off" in the list; J does nothing, ↓ still moves; ⌘/ opens the list even so. The "/" in the empty search box goes while single keys are off.

try: The other doors to the list
how:
1. Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) and read Go to and the foot of the window
2. Open the bell (G then N) and find "Keyboard shortcuts are here" under "Notices"
3. Open Maison AI (bottom right)
expect: Go to ends with "Keyboard shortcuts" and the foot says "? all shortcuts"; the bell holds "Keyboard shortcuts are here — Press ? on any page to see them", which opens the list; Maison AI offers "Keyboard shortcuts for this page".

how: 1. On a Windows computer, read the chip beside Search in the wide side navigation and the foot of the search window
expect: Windows shows Ctrl+K and Ctrl Enter — never ⌘; a Mac shows ⌘K and ⌘↵.

how: 1. On your phone open Leads and a lead's Tasks tab
expect: No key chips anywhere — not in the search box, not in menus.

try: Jump to Messages from the keyboard
how:
1. Point at "Messages" in the side navigation and read its tooltip
2. Click an empty part of the page, press G, then M
3. Press C, read the menu, then press Esc
expect: The tooltip reads Messages with the keys G M. G then M opens Messages from any page. On Messages, C opens "New message" ("A member", "A new group", "A client"); Esc closes it.
in10: Different from 1.0: G then M, where 1.0 had G then I (Inbox)
